policy.zero: Minor heritage records, ordinary amenities or one modest site cluster.
policy.one: At least one attraction scoring 75+, or two genuinely independent attractions scoring 60+.
policy.two: An 85+ attraction, at least two 70+ attractions and at least three meaningful 60+ attraction or 75+ genuine-trail experiences.
policy.three: A 90+ attraction, at least three 80+ attractions and at least five 70+ attraction or 80+ genuine-trail experiences.
policy.exclusions: Food, parking, toilets, picnic provision and other practical amenities never create a town rating.
policy.trailRule: Only explicitly scored curated trails with a responsible non-OSM external route source count towards depth. Trails cannot create rating 1.
